title: 第5章 阴阳研究学院第6章 极乐无极神功不过如此
content_zh:
恰逢我急需助力，另外三颗智齿接连成型。
这次同样附带了三个储物空间，每个空间都配了一位美女器灵。
第二个空间我取名“纳实”，初始半径5201314光分。
里面复刻了整个太阳系，唯独没有生命存在。
现实世界的非生命体都能进入，正好用来做科学实验。
器灵名叫师婧纯，她能用“纳实”内的物质复制其他物品。
只要材料充足，复制能瞬间完成。
我已经用它复制了100架我的飞船，命名为“翌恒号”，停放在里面。
以后要用时直接复制一架，省得麻烦加燃料。
第三个空间叫“纳灵”，初始半径5201314光年。
里面是复刻的银河系，同样没有生命。
只有灵体能进入，适合用来试验灵体技能。
器灵名叫师婧馨。
她能施展我已知的任何技能，还能随意设置等级，方便测试技能效果。
第四个空间叫“纳生”，初始半径5201314十亿秒差距。
里面复刻了整个宇宙，除了没有智慧生命，其余应有尽有。
只有生命体可以进入，正好用来携带我的伴侣们。
她们要是习惯家乡的生活，就能住在复刻的家乡环境里。
器灵名叫师婧露。
她拥有传送能力，能带着我的伴侣去任何星球，还能给我提供实时地图。

现在，“纳虚”“纳实”“纳灵”“纳生”都在“灵识空间”开了出入口，彼此间能自由进出。
……
一下多了三件神器，我脑子里冒出个念头：要不要先把其他牙齿舍弃掉？
早舍弃，早升级。
不过素衣她们定的下一步计划，需要我维持一定的颜值。
在修炼界，我30岁已经算有些显老，要是没了牙，根本撑不起门面。
能升级的器官尽早升级，“入梦”的机会可以攒着，等需要时再用。
最后我决定，先让胃、脾、一侧的肾，还有4颗靠近智齿的大牙先升级。
肾必须升级了，这段时间它实在太拖后腿。
进入修炼界还不到100天，它已经不堪大任。
……
按计划，下一步要去神木星人设在玄木星的一所大学历练。
知己知彼，才能百战百胜。
这所大学名字很长，叫“神木星生命科学院下属玄木星分院之附属阴阳研究学院”，简称“阴阳研究学院”。
神木星人虽是神级文明，称霸一方，但距离冠绝寰宇还差得远。
附近空域还有其他神级文明，他们也面临多方势力制衡。
神木星人同时也是二级科技文明，水平和地球当前接近。
他们对科学的执着，并不亚于对修炼的热忱。
设立阴阳研究学院，实际是为了从附属的玄级文明中挑选天赋异禀的人才，进行基因融合改良，寻求突破圣级文明的契机。
每百年虫洞开放，他们都会下发一定数量的入学资格证，让各个玄级文明推荐优秀个体前往深造，随时可以入学。

双修宫也有几张资格证，一直没派上用场。
content_en:
Just when I was in urgent need of help, three more wisdom teeth were formed one after another.
This time it also comes with three storage spaces, each space is equipped with a beautiful weapon spirit.
I named the second space "Nashi" with an initial radius of 5201314 light minutes.
The entire solar system is replicated inside, except that there is no life.
Inanimate objects from the real world can enter, which is perfect for scientific experiments.
The weapon spirit's name is Shi Jingchun, and she can use the material in "Nashi" to copy other items.
As long as there are enough materials, copying can be completed instantly.
I have used it to replicate 100 copies of my spaceship, named "Yuheng", and parked them inside.
When you need to use it in the future, just make a copy to save yourself the trouble of refueling.
The third space is called "Naling", with an initial radius of 5,201,314 light years.
Inside is a replica of the Milky Way, also without life.
Only spirits can enter, so it is suitable for testing spirit skills.
The weapon spirit's name is Shi Jingxin.
She can cast any skill I know, and can set the level at will to test the effect of the skill.
The fourth space is called "Nason", with an initial radius of 5201314 billion parsecs.
The entire universe is reproduced inside, except that there is no intelligent life, and everything else is there.
Only living things can enter, which is perfect for carrying my friends.
If they get used to the life in their hometown, they can live in a replica of their hometown environment.
The weapon spirit's name is Shi Jinglu.
She has the ability to teleport, take my partner to any planet, and provide me with real-time maps.
Now, "Naxu", "Nasubi", "Naling" and "Nasheng" have all opened entrances and exits in the "spiritual consciousness space", and they can freely enter and exit each other.
…
There were three more artifacts at once, and a thought came to my mind: Should I discard the other teeth first?
Give up early and upgrade early.
However, Suyi and the others' next plan requires me to maintain a certain appearance.
In the world of cultivation, 30 is already considered a bit old for me. If I lose my teeth, I won’t be able to support my appearance.
Upgrade organs that can be upgraded as soon as possible, and the opportunity to "dream" can be saved for later use when needed.
In the end, I decided to upgrade the stomach, spleen, one kidney, and the four big teeth near the wisdom teeth first.
The kidney must be upgraded, it is really holding us back during this period.
It has been less than 100 days since it entered the world of cultivation, and it is already unable to bear its responsibilities.
…
According to the plan, the next step is to go to a university located on Xuan Jupiter to gain experience.
Only by knowing yourself and the enemy can you be victorious in every battle.
The name of this university is very long. It is called "Yin-Yang Research College affiliated with XuanJu Planet Branch of ShenJu Planet Academy of Life Sciences", or "Yin-Yang Research College" for short.
Although the Shenmu people are a god-level civilization and dominate one area, they are still far from being the best in the world.
There are other god-level civilizations in the nearby airspace, and they also face checks and balances from many parties.
The Jupiter people are also a second-level technological civilization, and their level is close to that of the earth.
Their dedication to science is no less than their enthusiasm for cultivation.
The purpose of establishing the Institute of Yin-Yang Research is actually to select talented talents from the affiliated Xuan-level civilization, carry out genetic fusion and improvement, and seek opportunities to break through to the Saint-level civilization.
Every hundred years when the wormhole opens, they will issue a certain number of admission certificates, allowing each Xuan-level civilization to recommend outstanding individuals for further studies, and they can enroll at any time.
Shuang Xiugong also has several qualification certificates, but they have never been put to use.
